_note: 學習路徑內容第24批 #4／6：慣用動名詞句型 gerund idioms（eng.t_adv.nonfinite.gerund-idioms，學測級／高階）。固定句型後接動名詞 V-ing：feel like + V-ing（想要）、can't/couldn't help + V-ing（忍不住）、be worth + V-ing（值得）、It's no use/good + V-ing（…沒有用）、look forward to + V-ing（to 為介系詞）。誘答鎖『誤用 to 不定詞／原形／過去式』等唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix gid_）。

units.title_zh: 慣用動名詞句型（feel like／worth／no use + V-ing）
units.can_do: 我能在 feel like、can't help、be worth、It's no use、look forward to 等固定句型後正確使用動名詞（V-ing）。
units.situation_group: 非限定動詞：慣用動名詞句型
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'feel like' meaning 'want' is followed by the -ing form (gerund): 'I feel like taking a walk' (not 'to take').
claims.verification_ref: feel like（想要）後接 V-ing（I feel like taking a walk，非 to take）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: '(be) worth' is followed by the -ing form: 'This book is worth reading' (not 'to read').
claims.verification_ref: be worth 後接 V-ing（This book is worth reading，非 to read）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'It's no use' and 'It's no good' are followed by the -ing form: 'It's no use worrying about it' (not 'to worry').
claims.verification_ref: It's no use/good 後接 V-ing（It's no use worrying，非 to worry）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'can't/couldn't help' (meaning 'can't stop oneself') is followed by the -ing form: 'She couldn't help laughing.' Also note 'look forward to' takes the -ing form because 'to' is a preposition here: 'I look forward to seeing you.'
claims.verification_ref: can't/couldn't help（忍不住）後接 V-ing（couldn't help laughing）；look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing（look forward to seeing you）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Some fixed expressions are followed by the -ing form (gerund): feel like + V-ing (= want), be worth + V-ing (= worthwhile), can't help + V-ing (= can't stop).
teach.zh_hint: 固定句型 feel like／be worth／can't help 後接動名詞 V-ing。

teach.body: I feel like taking a walk after dinner.
teach.zh_hint: 晚餐後我想去散步。feel like 後接 V-ing：taking。

teach.body: 'It's no use' and 'It's no good' are also followed by V-ing: It's no use crying over spilt milk.
teach.zh_hint: It's no use／good 後接 V-ing。

teach.body: This museum is worth visiting twice.
teach.zh_hint: 這間博物館值得去兩次。be worth 後接 V-ing：visiting。

teach.body: In 'look forward to', the word 'to' is a preposition, so it is followed by V-ing, not the base verb: I look forward to seeing you.
teach.zh_hint: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing。

teach.body: She couldn't help laughing at the joke.
teach.zh_hint: 她聽到笑話忍不住笑了。couldn't help 後接 V-ing：laughing。

practice.stem: 選正確：I feel like ____ a walk.（想去散步）

distractor_rationales.to take: feel like 後接動名詞 V-ing，不接 to 不定詞。
distractor_rationales.take: feel like 後要用 -ing 形：taking，不用原形。
distractor_rationales.took: feel like 後用 V-ing（taking），不用過去式。

practice.feedback: feel like taking：feel like 後接 V-ing。

practice.stem: 選正確：This movie is worth ____.（值得一看）

distractor_rationales.to watch: be worth 後接動名詞 V-ing，不接 to 不定詞。
distractor_rationales.watch: be worth 後要用 -ing 形：watching，不用原形。
distractor_rationales.watched: be worth 後用 V-ing（watching），不用過去式。

practice.feedback: worth watching：be worth 後接 V-ing。

practice.stem: 選正確：It's no use ____ about it now.（擔心也沒用）

distractor_rationales.to worry: It's no use 後接動名詞 V-ing，不接 to 不定詞。
distractor_rationales.worry: It's no use 後要用 -ing 形：worrying，不用原形。
distractor_rationales.worried: It's no use 後用 V-ing（worrying），不用過去式。

practice.feedback: It's no use worrying：It's no use 後接 V-ing。

practice.stem: 選正確：She couldn't help ____ when she heard the joke.（忍不住笑）

distractor_rationales.to laugh: couldn't help（忍不住）後接動名詞 V-ing：laughing，不接 to 不定詞。
distractor_rationales.laugh: couldn't help 後要用 -ing 形：laughing，不用原形。
distractor_rationales.laughed: couldn't help 後用 V-ing（laughing），不用過去式。

practice.feedback: couldn't help laughing：can't/couldn't help 後接 V-ing。

practice.stem: 選正確：I look forward to ____ from you soon.（期待很快收到你的消息）

distractor_rationales.to hear: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後接動名詞 V-ing：hearing，不接 to 不定詞。
distractor_rationales.hear: look forward to 後要用 -ing 形：hearing，不用原形。
distractor_rationales.heard: look forward to 後用 V-ing（hearing），不用過去式。

practice.feedback: look forward to hearing：to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I look forward to seeing you again.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：look forward to seeing（to 是介系詞、後接 V-ing）、again、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。片語連讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: I feel like having a cup of tea.
lines.intonation: feel like having 連讀、tea 句尾下收

lines.text: This book is really worth reading.
lines.intonation: worth reading 連讀、reading 句尾下收
